design_detail: Analysis of US National Survey on Drug Use and Health (2015–2019) for past-year methamphetamine use and use disorder, with national death-certificate data for psychostimulant-involved overdose deaths.
can_establish: National trends in self-reported use, use disorder and coded overdose deaths.
cannot_establish: Causes of the trends; deaths attributable to methamphetamine alone (most involve opioids).

sample.recruitment: Household survey; excludes homeless, incarcerated and institutionalized people, who have higher use.

outcomes.operationalization: Past-year use; use disorder; overdose deaths involving psychostimulants with abuse potential (T43.6).

analysis.effect_sizes: [to be extracted from PDF] (prevalence by year; percentage changes; death counts)

interpretation_gap.results_show: Rising use, use disorder and psychostimulant-involved deaths, 2015–2019.

replication.where_it_stands: Official data; later NSDUH years should be added at update.

risk_of_bias.reasoning: Standard national data with known coverage gaps.
